description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans identifier types including GrainId, UniqueKey, SiloAddress, and related functionality, verifying their encoding, decoding, interning, serialization, and parsing behaviors. It uses Xunit testing framework

classes.name: IdentifierTests
classes.description: Contains various test methods for Orleans identifier types, including GrainId, UniqueKey, SiloAddress, GrainReference, and related serialization/parsing behaviors.

methods.name: GrainIdUniformHashCodeIsStable
methods.description: Verifies that GrainId.GetUniformHashCode returns a consistent, stable hash value.

methods.name: UniqueKeyKeyExtGrainCategoryDisallowsNullKeyExtension
methods.description: Tests that creating a KeyExtGrain category UniqueKey with null extension throws an ArgumentNullException.

methods.name: UniqueKeyKeyExtGrainCategoryDisallowsEmptyKeyExtension
methods.description: Tests that creating a KeyExtGrain category UniqueKey with an empty extension throws an ArgumentException.

methods.name: UniqueKeyKeyExtGrainCategoryDisallowsWhiteSpaceKeyExtension
methods.description: Tests that creating a KeyExtGrain category UniqueKey with whitespace extension throws an ArgumentException.

methods.name: ParsingUniqueKeyStringificationShouldReproduceAnIdenticalObject
methods.description: Checks that parsing the string representation of UniqueKey produces an equivalent object for various cases.

methods.name: GrainIdShouldEncodeAndDecodePrimaryKeyGuidCorrectly
methods.description: Verifies encoding and decoding of GrainId with Guid keys over multiple iterations.

methods.name: GrainId_ToFromPrintableString
methods.description: Ensures that GrainId can be serialized to and parsed from its string form accurately.

methods.name: GrainId_TryParseFromPrintableString
methods.description: Tests the success of TryParse method for GrainId string serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: GrainId_RoundTripJsonConverter
methods.description: Verifies JSON serialization and deserialization round-trip for GrainId.

methods.name: TestGrainIds
methods.description: Provides sample GrainId instances for testing.

methods.name: UniqueTypeCodeDataShouldStore32BitsOfInformation
methods.description: Checks that UniqueKey's type code encodes 32 bits of information.

methods.name: UniqueKeysShouldPreserveTheirPrimaryKeyValueIfItIsGuid
methods.description: Validates that UniqueKey preserves Guid primary key and key extension values correctly.

methods.name: UniqueKeysShouldPreserveTheirPrimaryKeyValueIfItIsLong
methods.description: Verifies that UniqueKey preserves Long primary key and key extension values correctly.

methods.name: ID_Interning_GrainID
methods.description: Tests interning of GrainId instances to ensure identical IDs reference the same object.

methods.name: ID_Interning_string_equals
methods.description: Tests string interning to verify that equivalent strings are interned to the same object.

methods.name: ID_InternOrCreate_derived_class
methods.description: Checks interning behavior for objects derived from the same base class.

methods.name: Interning_SiloAddress
methods.description: Ensures that identical SiloAddress instances are interned and reference the same object.

methods.name: Interning_SiloAddress2
methods.description: Verifies that different SiloAddresses are not interned as the same object.

methods.name: Interning_SiloAddress_Serialization
methods.description: Checks that serialization preserves object identity for interned SiloAddresses.

methods.name: SiloAddress_ToFrom_ParsableString
methods.description: Tests conversion of SiloAddress to and from its string representation.

methods.name: GrainReference_Test1
methods.description: Tests creation, serialization, and round-trip behavior of GrainReference objects.

methods.name: TestGrainReference
methods.description: Helper method to test GrainReference equality and serialization.

methods.name: RoundTripGrainReferenceToKey
methods.description: Helper method to serialize and deserialize GrainReference via key string.
